guidance: The sequence shows practical prerequisites; independent preparation can run in parallel. Group membership is a planning aid, not evidence. Every row remains open until its complete statement and exact gap are satisfied.
authorityBoundary: Technical delegation permits evidence-based review. The live owning chat retains coordinated private/live actions; passwords, MFA, security prompts and production actions are not simulated or treated as completed.
productionRelease: Production release is a separate Wave 6 gate: authorized separate staging/production, migration rehearsal, isolated restore, monitoring/alert receipt, performance/accessibility certification, signed MSIX and controlled pilot evidence remain required.

prerequisites.input: Current shared source ownership and exact approved target
prerequisites.action: Coordinate with the live owning chat before any shared or live change; bind current source, approved migration/function lists and provider revisions.

prerequisites.input: Genuine independent actors and permission controls
prerequisites.action: Privately prepare permitted/forbidden tenant/entity/branch sessions, source capability and entitlement changes, a distinct MFA approver, and the separately authorized MFA operator.
Prepare scoped transition history, opportunity revisions, matching financial statements, obligation residuals and retained manifests; record source versions and controlled late commit/backfill cases.

prerequisites.input: Reviewed private providers and actual external transport
prerequisites.action: Use the owning chat for private provider configuration and bounded worker routing repair; verify deployed readback, actual signed receipts, safe destinations and reconciled invocation/usage outcomes.

prerequisites.input: Exact Connected Windows package and new private profile
prerequisites.action: Privately provision the exact approved account/package/profile and complete Connected sign-in/MFA; then execute the native protocol. Secure-store/disk-full cases require a separately reviewed reversible failure harness.

prerequisites.input: Independent contention and target workload readiness
prerequisites.action: Privately prepare the reviewed PostgreSQL transport and genuine sessions, complete no-egress observation and job quiescence; execute every named committed race and the 500-company/2,000-session measured protocol.

prerequisites.input: Current source quality and complete coverage evidence
prerequisites.action: Under the owning chat SDK schedule, bind all current source/provider inputs and complete deterministic fixtures, critical branch coverage, analysis and native variant evidence.

groups.name: Complete provider readiness and current quality
groups.next: Close readiness/version drift, deterministic per-requirement fixtures and critical coverage only after each provider and native evidence set is complete.
